about: For each skill with an eval suite under .claude/evals/<skill>/: the digest of the skill and its suite at the last decision, and whether the eval ran (with scores) or was skipped (with the reason and who decided). pnpm check:skill-evals fails when the digest changes. The eval costs money, so the developer decides: run it, or record a skip. Reasoning: aimeat/scripts/check-skill-evals.ts.

aimeat-writing.note: Three language-context rows (input validation, format, the held button) with the aimeat-validate library; the skill text itself did not change; Jouni decided to skip, 2026-10-05
